result.summary: The page is mostly functional but has a clear content bug where a localization key is shown as a section title. There are also minor layout/content issues with truncated card text and a clipped bottom card.

issues.description: The section title displays the raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of the intended human-readable text.
issues.suggestion: Replace the localization key with the proper translated string, e.g., 'Popular near you', and verify the localization file is loaded correctly.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' horizontal list, the third restaurant name appears truncated as 'Trattoria Picco' instead of showing the full name.
issues.suggestion: Allow wider cards or use an ellipsis with full text available on tap; ensure long names are handled gracefully.

issues.description: The bottom restaurant card in the 'Popular' section is partially cut off, showing only the top half of the pizza image and the '-20%' badge.
issues.suggestion: Add enough bottom padding or make the list scrollable so the last card is fully visible without being clipped.
